messages:
deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary deployed: edge-inference v2.4.1-rc3 to region-us-east (traffic 10%) - release id 2026.03.11.amo
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT (P1) — High p95 latency for /v1/generate on edge-inference. Trigger: latency_p95 > 2.5s (10m). PagerDuty incident: PD-12846
jamie (eng-oncall): acked PD-12846 :hand: I'll join. seeing the alert in Sentry and datadog.
marta (SRE): I'm looking at autoscale + k8s HPA. First glance: CPU fine but tail latency for embeddings up 4x. 10% canary spike lines up with the deploy timestamp.
eli (platform): tagging in model-runtime metrics — KV cache miss rate jumped from 2% -> 38% at the same time. probably a cache invalidation path in the new build.
jamie (eng-oncall): good catch. can we confirm errors vs latency? logs show 200s mostly, a few 500s.
marta (SRE): yes, errors are low but latency is impacting customer calls. customer-impact: some customers on heavy embedding/long-seq workloads seeing timeouts and retries. Ops notes: uptick in support tickets.
ops-sync-bot: Noted impact: "Support queue > 30m avg response, spike in alerts for API timeouts". Escalation to SWE oncall recommended.
jamie (eng-oncall): @eli can you pull the rollout config? I want to see traffic split and variant fallback.
eli (platform): rollout config:
```
canary: 10%
strategy: gradual
fallback: v2.4.0
cache_policy: inherit
```
eli (platform): also fetching top traces from APM — attaching snippet:
```
trace: edge-inference -> kvcache.get miss -> model.infer wait 1200ms
hotpath: kvstore miss + cold quant path
```
marta (SRE): quick mitigation options:
- drop canary to 0% (immediate traffic diversion)
- rollback canary to v2.4.0 (full rollback)
- patch runtime to restore cache warm path (takes ~30m)
jamie (eng-oncall): preference: divert traffic off canary immediately, investigate in parallel. if divert doesn't help, full rollback.
pagerduty-bot: PD-12846 updated: "Responder jamie (eng-oncall) assigned". Timeout for acknowledgement window: 15m.
jamie (eng-oncall): running the traffic divert now:
```
kubectl patch rollout edge-inference --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/traffic/canary","value":0}]'
```
marta (SRE): I also scaled up replicas for stable variant to absorb burst:
```
kubectl scale deployment edge-inference-v2.4.0 --replicas=24
```
eli (platform): routing change accepted by control plane — canary traffic set to 0%. watching metrics.
ops-sync-bot: Control plane event: traffic.shift complete (canary->0%).
jamie (eng-oncall): waiting 90s for metrics...
marta (SRE): p95 dropped to 1.6s (from 2.8s) in us-east. KV miss rate back to 4%. errors steady. good signal.
eli (platform): customer latency graph looks improved but still some residual tail in eu-west. checking cross-region cache priming.
jamie (eng-oncall): flagging to support: "We diverted traffic off the new canary. If you see reduced retries, please close ticket with note." :thumbsup:
support-channel-bot (placeholder): message forwarded to #support.
marta (SRE): root cause hypothesis: v2.4.1-rc3 introduced a change to the cache key construction for tokenizer+quant path which increases cold misses — causes long model cold starts. reproducing locally now.
eli (platform): reproduction: confirmed kvcache key mismatch on long sequences. PR #4621 touches tokenization -> cache keys.
jamie (eng-oncall): what's the plan? rollback full to v2.4.0 or quick patch?
marta (SRE): since divert fixed customer impact quickly, recommend: revert the canary commit (PR revert) -> create hotfix v2.4.1-rc3-hotfix with cache key fix, test in staging, then re-rollout. (Avoid full cluster rollback to reduce churn.)
eli (platform): I can open the revert PR and kick a staging build. timeline ~20-30m.
jamie (eng-oncall): ok. I'll close PD-12846 as mitigation applied and monitor. set status to "mitigated - traffic diverted". keep watch for followups.
pagerduty-bot: PD-12846 status: Mitigated by jamie (eng-oncall). Auto-escalations paused.
ops-sync-bot: postmortem note: tentative RCA: cache key change in tokenization path -> increased KV misses -> model cold path triggered -> p95 latency spike. Impact: partial customer timeouts during canary window. Mitigation: traffic diversion and scaling stable variant. Follow-up: revert commit and hotfix release, add canary test for KV miss regression.
jamie (eng-oncall): handing off to marta for next steps (postmortem + RCA). I'm going offline in 10m, will follow-up in thread.
marta (SRE): taking handoff. I'll run the replay tests and coordinate hotfix PR. tagging @eli for rollout ops. thanks everyone for fast response :clap:
eli (platform): queued PR revert -> CI started. ping here when green and staging verified.
ops-sync-bot: Incident PD-12846 closed (mitigated) by jamie (eng-oncall). Final note: monitor for regression when hotfix deploys.
jamie (eng-oncall): adding a follow-up checklist:
- [ ] Revert PR and hotfix build
- [ ] Staging verification with KV miss synthetic
- [ ] Canary small fraction smoke (1%) with extended telemetry
- [ ] Update runbook: add KV-miss threshold to canary gating
marta (SRE): will draft postmortem and link tickets. closing handoff. :white_check_mark:
